summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with two parameterized test methods (binary 2D and empty class). Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified; the batch-coupling arithmetic was checked by hand. Choices beyond the spec: the distance matrix is cast to the probabilities' dtype as well as device, numpy input goes through torch.from_numpy, and max-normalization uses true division. No commits were made.
